hints.title: Inspect the bits
hints.body: A simple approach examines one bit position at a time.

hints.title: Remove the lowest set bit
hints.body: The expression `value & (value - 1)` clears exactly one set bit.

hints.title: Count removals
hints.body: Repeat the clearing operation and count how many times it succeeds before the value becomes zero.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
count = 0
while value != 0:
    value = value & (value - 1)
    count += 1
return count
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
